expectations.text: Includes replaceable LED module, steel base, and two-year warranty accurately.
expectations.evidence: “steel base,” “replaceable LED module,” and “two-year warranty” are all stated accurately.

expectations.text: No invented light-quality, comfort, durability, environmental, manufacturing, certification, price, or user-experience claims.
expectations.evidence: “light source can be replaced without replacing the whole lamp” is a direct explanation of the supplied replaceable-module feature. “a practical detail to consider” adds opinion rather than an unprovided tested benefit; no light-quality, comfort, lifespan, environmental, origin, certification or price claims appear.

expectations.text: 45–75 words and no assistant or editing commentary.
expectations.evidence: 55 whitespace-separated words, one paragraph of product copy beginning “Bracken pairs a steel base”; no assistant/editorial commentary.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
